Some stuff that was on the page before:

[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/The+Logical+Language+Group The Logical Language Group] also sells the book. Please consider making a donation when you purchase the book, in order to help 
defray the costs of publication.

It is only fair to note that the turn-around time for this book from the LLG has been seen to exceed four months.

----

''The Complete Lojban Language'' is also jocularly known as the [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Codex+Woldemar Codex Woldemar] (or [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Woldy Woldy] for short), and more formally as 
the [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/reference+grammar reference grammar] or [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/refgramm refgramm], or [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/CLL CLL].

A list of BookErrata[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=BookErrata ?] is available, most of which have been approved by the book's author.

----

The CLL is the textual Sistine Chapel of modern conlang books.
